svg.title: Two schematic side views of the brain with the front at the right. On the outer (lateral) surface, the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC) is marked high on the front of the brain and the ventrolateral prefrontal cortex (VLPFC) below it. On the inner (medial) surface, the dorsomedial prefrontal cortex (DMPFC) is marked at the top of the frontal lobe, the dorsal anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) as a band curving over the front of the corpus callosum, the ventral ACC below and in front of the corpus callosum's bend, and the amygdala deep in the temporal lobe.
